notes.title: Patch 2.5 Bugfixing, Jokes and Better Tutorials
notes.content:
Added more jokes to the intro sequence (don't know if better jokes, just more).
Added tutorial sequences to better explain how the daily mood system works.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Vp6GSNS/Tut-Explicacion.png[/img]

Fixed some bugs that prevented users from entering or exiting the gallery and viewing their score in the dancing minigame.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/vPrV660/BugFix.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 2.0 Main Menu and Gallery
notes.content:
This update we have focused on giving a cooler look at the [b]main menu [/b]and most important adding a [b]Gallery[/b] where you can unlock[b] art, profiles and trivia[/b] for each character once you get at least one ending with each one.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/N2TfLnz/gal03.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/x16HTPW/gal04.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/C5S6m5L/gal05.png[/img]

If you already completed the game you may need to get an ending again to unlock this (bad or good ending and in any difficulty), sorry for any inconvenience.

[b]Just click on the sides of the screen to scroll the gallery.[/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ry0XxTZ/gal01.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/G0NvXGG/gal02.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update 1,82 Achievements
notes.content: Even smaller changes, this achievement problem is making us age 20 years, but we think is fixed. We also added a new achievement.

notes.title: Small Update 1,81
notes.content: There was a bug with the persistent data on the game that made that some achievement and content that could only be accessed on a second playtrough was unlocked right from the start. Our apologies to the users that were affected by this, if any, other had any achievement unlocked by default or stuff like that please let us know. We appreciate it.

notes.title: Update 1,8
notes.content:
[h2][b]Animated Endings[/b][/h2]

We have included now animated endings with the chibby children's book's style that we have been using for some of the minigames.
To avoid spoilers we are not putting any of the animated endings here, but we hope you enjoy them.

[h2][b]Dificulty Settings
[/b][/h2]
Now when you initiate a new game you will be abe to choose two diferent game modes.

In [b]Casual Mode you [/b]can make some mistakes and still get the {b}Good Endings{/b}.
In [b]Challenge Mode[/b] you will need to use the [b]Daily Bonus System[/b] and respond perfectly in order to obtain the [b]Good Endings.[/b]
Only in [b]Challenge Mode[/b] can you get the [b]Achievements [/b]for the [b]Good Endings[/b].

notes.title: Patch 1,2 is live now!!
notes.content:
